purpose: Machine-readable map of the AI Operating System documentation layers, constraints, and dependencies.

files.name: 00_CONTEXT_GRAPH.md
files.responsibility: Master map and entry point guidance.
files.notes: Must be read first in every session.

files.name: manifest.json
files.responsibility: Machine-readable registry of system files.

files.name: CLAUDE.md
files.responsibility: Main AI Agent constitution and behavior guidelines.
files.notes: Defines agent constraints and project command patterns.

files.name: PRODUCT.md
files.responsibility: Product vision, definition, and constraints.

files.name: ARCHITECTURE.md
files.responsibility: System architecture, tech stack, and modularity principles.
files.notes: Defines modular boundaries and architecture rules.

files.name: SECURITY.md
files.responsibility: Security controls, credential policies, and vulnerability gates.
files.notes: Highest authority after user instructions. Blocks builds.

files.name: ROADMAP.md
files.responsibility: Strategic feature pipeline (Now/Next/Later) and milestone tracking.

files.name: PROJECT_MEMORY.md
files.responsibility: Active state summary and short-term memory block.
files.notes: Updated at the end of every agent task.

files.name: DECISIONS.md
files.responsibility: Architecture decision records (ADR).

files.name: RISK_REGISTER.md
files.responsibility: Risk assessment and mitigation plans.
files.notes: Maintains a running list of project risks.

files.name: LOOP.md
files.responsibility: Core development cycle and control flow.
files.notes: Guides execution steps of every task.

files.name: BUILD_TEST_FIX.md
files.responsibility: Automated build, test, and repair loop.

files.name: QA.md
files.responsibility: Quality gates, checklists, and definition of done.
files.notes: Defines quality expectations, not the run commands.

files.name: REVIEW.md
files.responsibility: Deliberate human-style review process and quality gates.
files.notes: Handles judgment checks after automation passes.

files.name: RELEASE.md
files.responsibility: Release prep, changelog creation, and rollback procedures.

files.name: OBSERVABILITY.md
files.responsibility: Monitoring, logging, and crash-reporting architectures.

files.name: AGENTS.md
files.responsibility: Multi-agent coordination and role descriptions.
files.notes: Distributes work tasks among different agent profiles.

files.name: PROMPTS.md
files.responsibility: Reusable agent prompts library.

files.name: TOKEN_OPTIMIZATION.md
files.responsibility: Token/cost reduction strategies and context size guidelines.

files.name: IDEAS.md
files.responsibility: Raw idea backlog and initial capture.

files.name: HIGH_SCORE_IDEAS.md
files.responsibility: Prioritized ideas evaluated using the project scoring formula.
files.notes: Filter gate to promote items to the roadmap.

files.name: ERRORS.md
files.responsibility: Registry of known exceptions, build errors, and resolved issues.

files.name: BOOTSTRAP_PROMPT.md
files.responsibility: Fresh clone setup guidance for newly instantiated agents.
